review_cases.name: Production Code Containing Forbidden Debug Statement
Fully Compliant API Endpoint With Pydantic Schema, Auth Guard, and Exception Handling
review_cases.diff:
--- a/server/app/api/compliant.py
+++ b/server/app/api/compliant.py
@@ -1,5 +1,25 @@
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+from app.domain.auth import declare_permission, PERMISSION_WORKSPACE_READ
+from app.core.errors import NotFoundError
+
+class ItemCreateSchema(BaseModel):
+    title: str
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+@router.post("/items", summary="Create item")
+@declare_permission(PERMISSION_WORKSPACE_READ)
+async def create_item(payload: ItemCreateSchema):
+    """Create item with schema validation."""
+    try:
+        return {"title": payload.title}
+    except NotFoundError:
+        raise
